map.6 个维度各按 1–5 分主观自评，默认等权（每项权重 1）；加权均值 = Σ(: Six dimensions are self-rated 1–5; weights are equal by default (1 each). Weighted mean = Σ(score×weight) ÷ Σweight; standardized total = weighted mean × 6. Ratings describe the self-assessment only: ≥4.5 excellent, 3.5–4.4 good, 2.5–3.4 fair, <2.5 poor. Record weights and evidence as needed; the result is not an investment decision—verify goals, acquisition cost, signed contracts and collections before increasing spend.
map.6 个维度各按 1–5 分主观自评，默认未选择；完成 6 项后才生成加权均值与复: Self-rate six dimensions 1–5; all six must be selected before producing a weighted mean and review ranking.
map.默认等权，可按目标自定义 0–10 权重，并记录评分依据与数据来源；权重合计须大: Weights default to equal; customize each to 0–10 and record scoring evidence and data sources. Total weight must be greater than 0.
